record.publisher: QUICK VISION STUDIOS YAZILIM TASARIM BILISIM IC VE DIS TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
record.offering: Graphics & Design app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
QUVIAI brings the AI tools creators use most into one studio. Turn a sketch into a photoreal render, write a sentence and get an image, edit photos with plain words, turn a scene into a video clip, generate 3D objects and compose music, all from your phone or tablet.

WHAT YOU CAN CREATE

• Image Generator: describe what you want, pick a ratio and choose from dozens of illustration and architecture styles.
• Render: upload a sketch, massing model or photo and get a photoreal render. Choose exterior, interior or site, day or night and the weather, or add a reference image to lock materials and mood.
• Edit Image: change a photo with a prompt, paint a mask to edit only one area, or remove the background in one tap.
• Multi Ref Edit: combine a main image with up to four reference images.
• Video: turn text or an image into a short cinematic clip, with optional opening and closing scenes.
• 3D Generator: create a 3D object from text or a single image, rotate it in the built-in viewer and download it as .glb.
• Music: describe a mood, add genre, instrument and mood tags, write your own lyrics if you like and get a 60, 90 or 120 second track.

YOUR LIBRARY

Every result is saved to the Library in your account: images, videos, 3D objects and music. Mark favourites, download, share, or select and delete in bulk. Tasks keep running in the background, so you can leave a screen while QUVIAI works. If a task fails, its credits are refunded.

MADE FOR PHONE AND TABLET

Light and dark mode that follow your system, tablet layouts with landscape support, and seven languages: English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese (Brazil) and Italian.

CREDITS AND PLANS

The free plan gives you 5 credits every day. Subscribe to Starter, Pro or Studio, monthly or yearly, for more credits each month, video creation and several tasks at once. Subscribers can also top up with one-time credit packs.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your account settings.

Terms and privacy: https://quvi.ai/all-terms
Support: support@quvi.ai

record.description_evidence:
Keep your AI coding agents running while you're away from your desk.

amux is the remote control for your AI engineering fleet. Monitor live Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini sessions, approve pending actions, inspect terminal output, coordinate work across agents, and recover from problems directly from your iPhone.

Think of it like GitHub Mobile for AI agents: the work happens on your laptop or server, amux puts the control panel in your pocket.

WHAT YOU CAN DO FROM YOUR PHONE

- Check overnight runs before getting out of bed
- Approve permission prompts before agents stall
- See exactly why an agent stopped (peek into live terminal output)
- Assign a new task to an idle session
- Send a steering instruction to redirect an agent mid-run
- Monitor your whole fleet at once: status, active tasks, token usage
- Manage the kanban board: see what's done, doing, and stuck
- Keep coding while traveling

BRING YOUR OWN SERVER

amux is open source. Run the single-file Python server on your Mac, Linux box, or cloud VM, then connect this app over Tailscale, your LAN, or amux Cloud. Your code and agents never leave your infrastructure.

BUILT FOR PARALLEL WORK

Instead of babysitting one AI assistant, run a whole fleet. One agent per feature, per bug, per module, all supervised from a single dashboard.

Self-healing keeps sessions alive: amux auto-compacts context, restarts on corruption, unblocks stuck prompts, and handles rate limits fleet-wide so your agents keep shipping overnight.

TWO ACCESS MODES

Native iOS app (this app): SwiftUI with optimized touch targets and full peek panel. Connects to your amux server over Wi-Fi, Tailscale, or the amux cloud tunnel.

Progressive Web App: Open your amux dashboard URL in Safari and install to home screen for a full-screen experience without the App Store.

REQUIREMENTS

- amux server running on Mac or Linux (free, open source: github.com/mixpeek/amux)
- Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, or Gemini CLI installed on your server
- Wi-Fi, Tailscale, or amux tunnel for remote access

Learn more at amux.io

Chapper is a powerful, privacy-first AI chat client for iPhone and iPad that runs on-device models and connects directly to local LLMs, LM Studio, self-hosted AI servers, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

No accounts. No forced cloud. No subscription.

Whether you run LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, or another OpenAI-compatible endpoint, Chapper gives you a polished, fully native iOS experience for chatting with your models, managing conversations, tuning inference settings, using tools, and working with local AI on your own terms.

Built in SwiftUI from the ground up, Chapper is designed to feel like a real iPhone and iPad app, not a web wrapper.

FEATURES

• On-Device Local Models
Run supported AI models directly on iPhone and iPad for private local inference, including MLX models and Apple Foundation Models where available.

• Personas
Create and switch between custom AI personas, each with their own system prompt, tone, and language. Built-in personas include Code Expert, Translator, Teacher, Analyst, Brainstormer, and more.

• Thought Process
See reasoning output from supported models in a collapsible panel above responses.

• Rich Markdown Rendering
Full support for code blocks, tables, lists, emphasis, and structured responses.

• Model Management
Browse, inspect, select, load, and unload models directly from the app where supported. View quantization, context length, tool support, vision support, and active status.

• MCP Tools
Built-in tool workflows for web search, current time, server status, model listing, chat search, file and directory access, URL fetching, export actions, and more.

• C.A.S.H. Terminal
A built-in sandboxed terminal environment for practical local workflows, file operations, shell scripting, and AI-assisted tool execution.

• Files App Integration
Access Chapper workspace files directly in the iOS Files app, including exports and tool-related content where supported.

• Memory
Save useful long-term information and inject it into conversations automatically for more consistent assistance across chats.

• Prompt Templates
Save and reuse common prompts instantly.

• Full Parameter Control
Adjust temperature, token limits, repeat penalty, Top-K, Top-P, Min-P, TFS-Z, Flash Attention, KV-cache offload, context length, keep-alive, structured output, and more.

• Search
Full-text search across chats and message history.

• Export
Export conversations in multiple formats including TXT, PDF, HTML, Markdown, JSON, CSV, and XML.

• Keychain Support
Store API keys securely using iOS Keychain.

• iCloud Sync
Optionally sync chats across devices with iCloud.

• Analytics Dashboard
View on-device usage stats and activity insights.

• Text to Speech
Listen to responses with native, local, or server-based TTS playback.

• Chat Info
Inspect timestamps, counts, tags, folder assignment, and other conversation metadata.

• Server Tools
Configure, save, and reuse server connections for a smoother local AI workflow.

• JSON Lab
Work with custom JSON requests and experimental API workflows directly inside Chapper.

• Chapper Pro
One-time purchase. Unlock unlimited chat history, all export formats beyond plain text, advanced sampling and structured output controls, MCP tools in normal chat, C.A.S.H. terminal access with shell scripting and AI shell tooling, premium personas and prompt templates, memory and analytics extras, iCloud sync, live vision chat, premium appearance options including additional app icons, and future Pro features. No subscription.

COMPATIBILITY

Chapper works with on-device models, LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, and OpenAI-compatible servers. Some features depend on your model or server.

PRIVACY

Chapper is built with privacy in mind. Your chats stay on your device unless you explicitly enable iCloud sync or connect to your own server. No accounts required. No third-party tracking.

Chapper is built for people who care about local AI, privacy, model control, and a true native iOS experience.
